title: Hazard Insurance Escrow on HECM Monthly Scheduled Payments
content:
Added to the withholdings from a new Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) scheduled payment is a hazard insurance escrow that builds, a twelfth at a time, the hazard renewal falling due a year after the next one.

1. When Cedarline advanced a hazard insurance premium on the loan — recorded among the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment advances — on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date, the escrow is the total of the hazard insurance premiums advanced in that window divided by 12.
2. When none was advanced in that window but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) is depleted with an annual hazard premium above 0.00, it is that annual hazard premium divided by 12.
3. Otherwise nothing.


*Window illustration (hypothetical handling date 8 July):* a hazard premium paid on 9 July of the previous year counts; one paid on 8 July of the previous year does not. A 1440.00 hazard premium in the window gives 120.00 a month.
